title: The Helix Bridge
visualBrief: Curved Singapore crossing with opposing six-strand and five-strand stainless helices, transparent rails, shaded walkway, four bay-side viewing pods and slender tripod piers.

reconstruction.note: Mapped pedestrian centerline determines curved plan. Four west-side viewpoint POIs and architect plan resolve the bay-facing pods, correcting the coarse area relation. Approximate four/five helical turns, clear platform connections, canopy leaves and hardware are photo/drawing reconstructions. The deck rises from shore to a reconstructed8.8m central height.
